# vercel agent

Generate an AGENTS.md file with Vercel deployment best practices

```
vercel agent [init] [options]
```

## Options

- `-y, --yes` — Skip confirmation prompt

## Examples

Generate AGENTS.md with Vercel best practices

```
$ vercel agent init
```

Skip confirmation prompt (useful for CI)

```
$ vercel agent init --yes
```

Global options (`--cwd`, `--scope`, `--token`, `--debug`, ...) also apply; see `global-options.md`.
